svg.aria-label: Checking the cure: a fully cured film with a non-tacky surface can be measured. A tacky surface means oxygen inhibition or too low a dose; add a cover sheet or extend the exposure. A gap at the edge is cure shrinkage; fill another layer and cure again. A tacky bottom means the layer is too thick or absorbs too strongly. IR can show whether the C=C double-bond peak at 1635 cm⁻¹ has disappeared.
